name: Lewd Mod
source:
Lewd Mod is a game where you play as a content moderator for a virtual social network. You're shown a mix of photos & have to decide if it needs to be removed, according to the strict guidelines the prudish SelfieBook bosses have given you. 

[From [url=https://hhrichards.itch.io/lewd-mod]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Lewd Mod是一款游戏，你可以在其中扮演虚拟社交网络的内容管理员。你会看到一堆照片，并且必须根据拘谨的SelfieBook老板给你的严格指导来决定是否需要将其删除。

[来自[url=https://hhrichards.itch.io/lewd-mod]itch.io[/url]]
